changelog:
- First release of the `oo-qichacha` skill for working with Qichacha through an OOMOL-connected account.
- Uses the `oo` CLI to run Qichacha connector actions without handling raw credentials directly.
- Supports reading a company’s historical outbound investments and exit details.
- Supports reading company shareholder records and subscribed contribution details.
- Includes guidance for schema-first action calls and first-time setup fallback when auth or connection errors occur.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@d6fb756`
summary: Qichacha (openapi.qcc.com). Use this skill for ANY Qichacha request — searching and reading data. Whenever a task involves Qichacha, use this skill instead of calling the API directly.
